luci-app-wwand.description: Grant access to the wwand modem status page

luci-app-wwand-log.description: Read the system log for the wwand log viewer on the modem status page. SEPARATE ROLE ON PURPOSE: rpcd cannot filter a method's arguments or its result, so granting `log read` grants the WHOLE system log — kernel, auth, dropbear, firewall — not just the wwand lines, which are picked out in the browser afterwards. Keeping it out of the luci-app-wwand role lets an operator be given the modem pages without the box's logs; the viewer says it cannot read them and everything else on the page still works.
